title: Decision to stop briefing new legacy-program members on its history

tellings.quote: and and Dylan Borland kind of hinted at this or actually pretty direct about it with with you where he said uh that there was a a choice a decision made to stop briefing new people in the legacy program on the history of the program.

plain: At some point a decision was made to stop telling new members of the "legacy program", a secret programme said to hold recovered non-human craft, about the programme's own history. Matthew Brown, who comes on the show as a Pentagon whistleblower, tells Michels that a man named Dylan Borland had been "pretty direct" about this in his own talk with Michels. If true, it would mean even insiders work without knowing where their programme came from.
